topics.title: Path Operations, Request Bodies & Pydantic v2 Validation
topics.objective: Define type-annotated API endpoints with automated request validation and OpenAPI documentation.
topics.exercise: Build an endpoint validating user registration payloads with custom email and password complexity validators.

topics.title: Hierarchical Dependency Injection (Depends)
topics.objective: Encapsulate database sessions, authenticated user contexts, and configuration access with Depends.
topics.example: async def get_db() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]: yield session
topics.exercise: Create a reusable authentication dependency verifying JWT Bearer tokens and returning an active User model.

topics.title: Asynchronous Database Access with SQLAlchemy 2.0 & asyncpg
topics.objective: Prevent event loop blocking using non-blocking async database queries and transaction context managers.
topics.exercise: Write an async CRUD service handling concurrent order creation inside an atomic database transaction.

topics.title: CORS, Rate Limiting & Security Headers Middleware
topics.objective: Harden FastAPI applications against CSRF, CORS misconfigurations, and brute-force abuse.
topics.exercise: Implement an IP-based sliding window rate limiter middleware returning 429 Too Many Requests.

topics.title: BackgroundTasks & WebSockets for Real-Time Events
topics.objective: Offload non-blocking post-request actions and stream bidirectional real-time messages.
topics.exercise: Create a WebSocket endpoint broadcasting live system telemetry updates to subscribed frontend clients.
